positions.title: Principal Development Manager
positions.description:
Principal Development Manager for the next generation payment solution.
●	Handle HR responsibilities for a team of 6 developers.
●	Perform all the project manager duties for this project and coordinate with the rest of the projects on schedules.
●	Run the daily Scrum, Sprint Kickoff, and Sprint Closeout meetings.
●	Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams as well as our customers to make sure all the product requirements are up-to-date.
●	Designed and selected the new technologies to be used for this new product.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
●	Responsible implementing the fix for the original architecture of the TCx Pay product which was deemed too slow and unreliable by our customers.
   ●	After the redesign the application was deployed by 6 different retailers in 3 different countries with more planned in 2021.
   ●	Improved the performance of the system and it is now faster than the ACE/EPS application that it is intended to replace.
   ●	All the reliability and compatibility issues were resolved.
   ●	New PIN Pad devices and functionality were also added as a result.
●	Worked on several projects to bring the legacy payment applications up-to-date based on the latest credit card company’s mandates and changing technologies.
●	Represented (and still do) Toshiba at all U.S. Payments Forum meetings since 2017.
●	Represented Toshiba at EMVCo meetings from 2017 to 2019.
●	Traveled with the sales team to many meetings involving large customers to provide technical sales support.
●	Gave payment related presentations at several Toshiba Customer Focus Conferences.
●	Provided onsite support for the initial TCx Pay deployments to help the customers with the transition.
